summary: Both independent R3 reviews found the same P1: v15/v12 verify the namespace parent at binding time but do not freeze that identity in FreshOutputReservation v1 or M6ReplayInputBinding v7. A same-path, same-ACL parent replacement can therefore pass runtime checks. The design must bind the parent identity at freeze and require exact equality at execution, handoff, and M6 archive acceptance.

limitations: Reviews were read-only and made no product, test, contract, gate, ledger, or historical-evidence changes.
No empirical training, M6 replay, PIT certification, budget consumption, or final-OOS access occurred.

blockers: Return to architecture and add an exact freeze-time namespace-parent binding to the reservation and v7 binding; compare it at execution, handoff, and archive acceptance.
Do not enter test design, red tests, implementation, code review, M7, CCC/Gate, server replay, or final OOS until the corrected design receives a fresh independent PASS.
